name: FSSAI Food Technology Officer Mock Exam - Practice Test 2
courseName: FSSAI Food Technology Officer Mock Exam

questions.question: Which agency regulates food safety standards in India?
questions.hint: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) is the apex food regulator.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of food pasteurization?
questions.hint: Pasteurization uses heat to kill disease-carrying bacteria and extend shelf life.

questions.question: The temperature range of Danger Zone for food safety is:
questions.hint: Pathogens replicate rapidly in foods kept between 5°C and 60°C.

questions.question: Which acid is naturally present in lemon?
questions.hint: Citrus fruits contain high levels of organic citric acid.

questions.question: HTST pasteurization of milk is carried out at:
questions.hint: High-Temperature Short-Time (HTST) pasteurizer runs at 71.7°C to 72°C for 15 seconds.

questions.question: What does HACCP stand for?
questions.hint: HACCP is a systematic preventive approach to food safety from biological/chemical hazards.

questions.question: The blue-green mold found on bread is typically:
questions.hint: Penicillium glaucum or digitatum is a common mold on organic starches.

questions.question: Food additive MSG stands for:
questions.hint: MSG is the sodium salt of glutamic acid, used as a flavor enhancer.

questions.question: Which vitamin is highly sensitive to heat and easily destroyed during cooking?
questions.hint: Ascorbic acid (Vitamin C) oxidizes and breaks down at boiling temperatures.

questions.question: The major protein present in cow's milk is:
questions.hint: Casein forms about 80% of total milk proteins.

questions.question: Which gas is filled in potato chip packets to prevent rancidity?
questions.hint: Nitrogen displaces oxygen, preventing oxidation of lipids.

questions.question: Water activity (aw) in foods represents:
options: Available free water for microbial growth
questions.hint: Water activity is the ratio of vapor pressure of food to pure water.

questions.question: Rigor mortis is related to the processing of:
questions.hint: Rigor mortis represents post-mortem stiffening of muscle fibers in meat.

questions.question: Canning of food was invented by:
questions.hint: Appert invented preservation by placing food in jars and heating them in 1810.

questions.question: FSS Act was enacted by the Parliament of India in the year:
questions.hint: The Food Safety and Standards Act was passed in 2006, consolidating old laws.
